name: claude-plugins-official
description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.
one_liner: An official, Anthropic-curated app store of add-ons for Claude Code, the AI coding assistant.
buyer: Honestly, nobody pays for the directory itself — the real buyer is a plugin author who wants distribution to Claude Code's users.
business_use_cases: A developer builds and lists a plugin here to get free distribution to Claude Code's entire user base.
An agency studies the featured plugins to standardize its own internal AI-assisted workflows.

money_ideas.idea: Build a plugin that solves one specific paid workflow (invoicing, CRM sync, compliance checks) and monetize a pro tier outside the free listing.

steal_this: Pick one repetitive task from your own job, build a tiny Claude Code plugin for it this weekend, and submit it here for free distribution.
